"each Lasombra you control" gets an additional vote. That's that simple.

non titled get 1 vote, Bishops get their regular 1+1=2 votes, Archbishops
get regular 2+1=3 votes, Cardinal get ther regular 3+1=4 votes and prisci
get 1 vote, thet still have only 1 "voice" in the Prisci sub-referendum. so
Gratiano usually gets 4 votes...

reyda
